tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (body). Every text token's contrast is quoted against it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, tiers, forms, the in-article CTA — anything that sits on the page with a hairline.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Secondary pricing CTA fill (Solo, Scale). A quiet filled button on white cards.

tokens.name: surface-translucent
tokens.usage: Sticky header behind a 14px backdrop blur (0.72 on the blog header).

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Secondary hero button, eyebrow pill, round arrow buttons on tinted grounds.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Code blocks, the bento alert tile, the maintenance bar, the dark button. Same value as ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary UI text on surface, surface-raised and every tint (17.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Long-form article body (18/1.7) and review quotes, on surface (13.4:1).

tokens.name: ink-quote
tokens.usage: Blockquote text, newsletter and coming-soon sub-copy, footer column links (8.6:1).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Lead paragraphs, card descriptions, table values, active TOC links (6.6:1).

tokens.name: ink-nav
tokens.usage: Top-nav links, inactive segmented-control options, breadcrumb links (5.3:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, small labels, bylines' role, footer text. 3.4:1 on surface — below 4.5:1 for its 11–13px uses; kept exact from the source, consider ink-nav where it must pass.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Dates on cards, mock-data notes, placeholder-tile labels. 2.6:1 — decorative metadata only; kept from the source.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: "No" and "—" cells in the comparison table. 2.0:1 — paired with the word itself, never colour alone.

tokens.name: ink-separator
tokens.usage: Breadcrumb "/" and the "·" between meta items. Not for words.

tokens.name: ink-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse: code, alert tile, maintenance bar (14.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent and the primary gradient (4.7:1 on accent). Also chip text on the 'most picked' badge.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default hairline: card borders, section rules inside articles, header bottom (0.06).

tokens.name: line-faint
tokens.usage: Table row dividers and borders of tinted tiles.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Block-label rules, FAQ separators, hr, phone frame.

tokens.name: line-control

tokens.name: line-dashed

tokens.name: line-on-inverse

tokens.name: fill-subtle

tokens.name: switch-off

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Regressions: shares, budget breaks, over-budget bars, WARNING callouts, month on a date tile. 4.2:1 — passes only at 18px+/bold; keep the word (WARNING, +1.3s) next to it.

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: WARNING callout and regression row background (0.06–0.09).

tokens.name: success

tokens.name: success-wash
tokens.usage: Engineering chip / registered button background.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: 6px live/status dot in eyebrows and the maintenance bar. Never text.

tokens.name: star

tokens.name: code-comment

tokens.name: code-key

tokens.name: code-string

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Numbers and booleans, on surface-inverse (12.3:1).
